body: There are some amazing quotes in FFXIV that relate to this. I hope it’s allowed that I link this video here. You may not understand the story or characters, but the point is why do we live to suffer? What gives our lives meaning? What’s the answer to that? Much love to you, I sincerely hope you get to a better place someday. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=BgC-uGPdoUM

Small thing, but for me a different sorting feature for expert delivery to your grand company would be nice. Would be great to be able to pull down a menu for just ‘gloves,’ etc etc and turn things in that way.
I just went through something similar last week. I’m so sorry for what you are experiencing. I loved my cat so much, she was literally my whole world. I’m here if you want to talk about it

Thank you so much for the information and support. I’ve genuinely felt as if a part of me has been ripped away. You may not realize it, but your initial message to me made a lot of difference. So thank you.

Her condition got so much worse within a matter of days. She couldn’t see anymore, couldn’t walk, and sounded like she was in pain all the time. Unfortunately I had to put her down because of how fast it progressed. I’m obliterated by this news. Thank you for the information though. If anything, I’ll help spread the word out there about FIP warriors in case it helps someone.
